newsitem.title: JAPAN: North Korea slams Cohen over U.S. troops remark.
newsitem.headline: North Korea slams Cohen over U.S. troops remark.

text.p: North Korea on Thursday criticised comments by U.S. Defence Secretary William Cohen in which he said the United States would not reduce troop levels in Asia even if the two Koreas were reunited.
"This outrageous comment puts military pressure on us and reveals the U.S. military forces' dangerous ambition for domination of the entire Korean peninsula," state-run Radio Pyongyang said.
The broadcast was monitored by the Radio Press news agency in Tokyo.

Cohen, who is now in South Korea as part of his first tour of Asia as defence secretary, told reporters before beginning his trip that the 100,000 U.S. troops in Asia would stay whatever happens in China or North Korea.
Cohen said the U.S. military presence, mostly based in Japan and South Korea, was the best guarantee of stability in the region.
